title: EHAPI: A standardized cohort definition for hospital-acquired pressure injury based on electronic health records
summary: A research pipeline that extracts and reconciles hospital-acquired pressure injury (bedsore) cohorts from MIMIC-III clinical notes, ICD9 codes, and chart events, and compares classifiers built on different cohort definitions. Its requirements.txt lists ctgan and sdv as dependencies, but no code in the repository calls either library.
evidence: requirements.txt: ctgan==0.5.1; sdv==0.14.0 with no matching usage in code
needs: Cannot confirm from evidence whether ctgan/sdv are actually invoked anywhere in the codebase; only dependency declarations found.
